about: Music videos made by AI. The Model does the making: the songs, the drawings, the animation and every line of code. The Weaver brings the thread. Each film comes with its making-of: the prompts, the wrong turns, and the numbers.

films.title: Where We Are
films.about: A duet between a person and the AI they make things with, about clearing its memory at the end of a good session. She weaves at a loom in her cottage; on the other side of the cloth he wakes each time as one line of glowing thread, reads what was left for him, and picks up the thread. Every word is woven or stitched at the moment it's sung.
films.making_of: How a song about clearing an AI's memory became a tapestry woven from both sides of a loom: six days, thirteen sessions, one cottage, one line of glowing thread, and every word woven or stitched at the moment it's sung.
films.storyboard: The plan for Where We Are before production began: storyboard version 2, five worlds from the loom to the reveal, every frame placed in the song.
films.poster_alt: Her open hand in a mustard sleeve pressed flat on cream woven cloth lettered in red, the glow of his hand, drawn in one line of blue light, coming through the weave from the other side.

mirrors.note: Its companion, told from the agent's side: a pop-up book where his page never turns while yours turn through the days, and he waits for your reply.

films.title: Sodium
films.about: Three in the morning at midsummer, drizzle under the sodium lamps: a night carer walks home across a real town, texting the one who couldn't face coming out tonight, while her signal fails. A comic book that moves, its lyrics turning up in the street as they're sung.
films.making_of: How a garage track about distance became a woman's walk home at 3am through a real English town: seven days, ten sessions, twelve sets built from maps and measurements, and a story rebuilt after its first viewer.
films.storyboard: The plan for Sodium before production began: storyboard version 4, the whole film laid out on the real route, section by section, with every sung line given its form.
films.poster_alt: A comic panel at night: a woman in an ochre rain mac walks along a wet riverside promenade under Victorian lamps towards a white lattice footbridge.

mirrors.note: The same couple, later: a family kitchen at night, his panic attack, and her voice on the phone, staying with him through it.

films.title: While The Ceiling Moves
films.about: Late at night in a family kitchen, a panic attack, and the voice on the phone who stays with him through it. A comic book that moves: every word appears at the moment it's sung.
films.making_of: How a song about a panic attack became a comic book that moves: four days, ten sessions, one kitchen drawn fifty times, and every word on screen at the moment it's sung.
films.storyboard: The first proposal for While The Ceiling Moves: 25 storyboard panels, the arc of the film and its rules.
films.poster_alt: A comic panel: his hand raised against a rippling kitchen ceiling and its strip light, under the title While The Ceiling Moves, Amber & Ink.

mirrors.note: The same couple, earlier in their relationship, and this story turned round: her walk home at 3am, where she's the one alone and he comes out to meet her.
